idea-plugin.name: Oracle Dictionary Inspector
idea-plugin.description:
Oracle dictionary inspector for DataGrip / IntelliJ IDEA Ultimate

Toad-style describe dialogs for Oracle objects, plus a dedicated tool window for sessions, locks, and execution plans — all inside IntelliJ.

How to open

  • Database panel → right-click a table / view / procedure / function / package / sequence / synonym → Oracle Dictionary Info
  • SQL editor → select an identifier (or place the caret on it) → right-click → Oracle Dictionary Info
  • Shortcut anywhere: Alt+Shift+O (macOS: ⌥+Shift+O)

What it does

  • Tables / Views — Columns, Keys, FK, Indexes, Checks, Triggers, plus a Data preview with 500-row paging + WHERE/ORDER BY filters, DDL and SELECT
  • Procedures / Functions / Packages — IntelliJ-editor source with line numbers, SQL syntax, and compile-error line markers; double-click an Errors row to jump to the line
  • Oracle Sessions tool window — V$SESSION browser, Locks, Long Ops, with per-session Current SQL / Wait History / Session Stats / Explain Plan sub-tabs; right-click → Kill Session
  • Localised: English (default) + Korean (한국어)
  • 100% read-only — except the explicitly confirmed Kill Session, every command is a SELECT

Full manual, screenshots, and setup guide on the GitHub repository.

DataGrip / IntelliJ IDEA Ultimate용 Oracle 딕셔너리 조회 플러그인

Toad 스타일의 객체 Describe 다이얼로그 + 세션·락·실행 계획 전용 Tool Window를 IntelliJ 안에서 그대로 제공합니다.

여는 방법

  • Database 패널에서 테이블/뷰/프로시저/펑션/패키지/시퀀스/시노님 우클릭 → Oracle Dictionary Info
  • SQL 에디터에서 식별자 선택(또는 캐럿 위치) → 우클릭 → Oracle Dictionary Info
  • 어디서나 단축키: Alt+Shift+O (macOS: ⌥+Shift+O)

주요 기능

  • 테이블·뷰 — Columns / Keys / FK / Indexes / Checks / Triggers + 500행 페이징 데이터 미리보기 + WHERE/ORDER BY 필터 + DDL / SELECT
  • 프로시저·펑션·패키지 — IntelliJ Editor 본문 (라인 번호, 신택스, 컴파일 오류 라인 강조). Errors 행 더블클릭 → Source 점프
  • Oracle Sessions Tool Window — V$SESSION 브라우저, Locks, Long Ops + 세션별 Current SQL / Wait History / Stats / Explain Plan sub-tab. 우클릭 → Kill Session
  • 다국어 — 영문(기본) + 한국어 (IDE 로케일 자동)
  • 100% 읽기 전용 — 명시 확인을 거치는 Kill Session 외 모든 명령은 SELECT

전체 사용 매뉴얼, 스크린샷, 설치 가이드는 GitHub 저장소에서 확인하세요.
idea-plugin.change-notes:
1.0.4 — Preserve session selection across Auto 5s refresh

  • The Sessions tool window now remembers which session row you had selected and the column sort order when the 5-second auto-refresh fires. Previously the selection (and therefore the Current SQL / Wait History / Stats / Explain Plan sub-tabs) flickered away every cycle.
  • If the previously selected session is still alive after the refresh, the row is re-selected and scrolled into view; if it has logged out or been killed, the sub-tabs clear gracefully.

1.0.3 — Slimmer in-IDE description

  • Trimmed the in-IDE Plugins-screen description to a concise summary (How to open + key features + GitHub link). The Marketplace listing page itself can host the full Getting Started content via the dashboard.
  • "How to open" section now spells out the right-click entry points on the Database panel and the SQL editor in addition to the Alt+Shift+O shortcut.
  • No runtime or behaviour changes from 1.0.2.

1.0.2 — Marketplace listing polish

  • Expanded plugin description with the full feature inventory in both English and Korean, so the in-IDE Plugins screen now matches the Marketplace page.
  • Synced README.md project structure and roadmap with the current codebase (PackageInfo, SimpleObjectInfo, Sessions UI, etc.).
  • No runtime or behaviour changes from 1.0.1.

1.0.1 — Marketplace moderation fixes

  • Replaced internal DbDataSource.getDelegate() with the public DbImplUtil.getMaybeLocalDataSource() across all JDBC repositories and the editor describe action.
  • Rewrote the Sessions tool window factory in Java so Kotlin no longer emits synthetic overrides of internal ToolWindowFactory default methods.

1.0.0 — initial release

Object dialogs

  • Tables / Views — Columns / Keys / FK / Indexes / Checks / Triggers / Data preview (500-row paging + WHERE/ORDER BY) / DDL / SELECT / Comments SQL.
  • Views use ALL_VIEWS.TEXT for the DDL tab (CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW).
  • Standalone Procedures / Functions — Source (IntelliJ editor, syntax + line-number markers for compile errors) / Execute template / Errors (double-click jumps to source line) / Arguments.
  • Packages — Spec / Body / Routines / Errors with per-source-type error highlighting and double-click jump.
  • Sequences / Synonyms — Property/Value dialogs.

Oracle Sessions tool window

  • Sessions / Locks / Long Ops tabs with auto-refresh (5s).
  • Sessions tab has client-side USER / STATUS / PROGRAM / MODULE filter.
  • Bottom sub-tabs: Current SQL, Wait History (V$SESSION_WAIT_HISTORY), Session Stats (curated V$SESSTAT), Explain Plan (V$SQL_PLAN with expensive-operation highlighting).
  • Right-click → Kill Session / Kill Holder with confirmation dialog.

Editor describe action

  • Single Alt+Shift+O shortcut handles every object type, supports SCHEMA.NAME, prefers the current dialog's OWNER.

Cross-cutting

  • Inline search on every table (just start typing).
  • Column widths persist via PropertiesComponent.
  • Localised: English (default) + Korean.
